fr_html: Le PRESIDENT ouvre la discussion sur le second alinéa de l'amendement de M. Hagerup. Cet alinéa a trait à l'indemnité à donner aux juges suppléants.
en_html: The PRESIDENT opened the discussion of the second Paragraph of M. Hagerup's amendment. This Paragraph dealt with the indemnities to be paid to deputy judges.
